description.value: Built in 1904 and reopened as a premier bed and breakfast in 2006, Barclay House is a restored Victorian home in Vancouver's West End offering six individually themed suites, several featuring clawfoot tubs and custom international furnishings. The property sits within walking distance of Stanley Park, the Seawall, and English Bay — some of the finest urban cycling in Canada. A full hot breakfast is included each morning, and free reserved parking in the lane behind the building is available for each room.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website policies page explicitly states 'There are bicycle storage facilities on the premises,' confirming on-site bike storage exists, though no lock type or enclosure details are provided and a disclaimer notes the property does not accept responsibility for lost or stolen bicycles. Free Wi-Fi is confirmed by the guest rooms page ('FREE Wireless internet connection') and corroborated by OSM tags internet_access=wlan and internet_access:fee=no. A notable discrepancy exists between the OSM email (info@barclayhouse.com) and the email prominently shown across all website pages (thebarclayhouse@yahoo.com), though info@barclayhouse.com does appear in the cancellation policy text, suggesting both may be active.
concerns: Email mismatch: OSM lists info@barclayhouse.com, but the website prominently displays thebarclayhouse@yahoo.com as the primary contact email on all pages; info@barclayhouse.com appears only within the cancellation policy body text.

Bike storage security ambiguous: the policies page uses the phrase 'bicycle storage facilities' without describing locks, enclosures, or access controls, and explicitly disclaims responsibility for lost, damaged, or stolen bicycles — a WWC follow-up call to confirm security level is advisable.
Subpage /guest-rooms.htm carries the title 'Guest Rooms - Richmond, CA Bed and Breakfast' — an apparent website template error, as all content clearly refers to Vancouver, BC.
OSM wheelchair=no is not explicitly corroborated by the website; the site links to an accessibility details page but that page's content was not available in the fetched content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Barclay House is an active, well-reviewed B&B in a premier cycling location adjacent to Stanley Park and the Seawall, with confirmed on-site bike storage facilities, free Wi-Fi, included breakfast, and free reserved parking — a solid WWC directory candidate pending clarification of bike storage security details.
enrichment_extras.notes: A toll-free number (1-800-971-1351) is listed on the website alongside the local number. Children under 15 are not accepted per the About page; the Policies page states the minimum age as 12 — a minor inconsistency on the website itself. No pets allowed.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: Policies page states: 'There are bicycle storage facilities on the premises.' No specifics on lock type, enclosure, or access mechanism provided. The same page includes a disclaimer that the property will not accept responsibility for lost, damaged, or stolen bicycles

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states the property is close to 'Vancouver's finest restaurants and shopping on Robson Street and in Yaletown' and within reach of Gastown and Chinatown dining areas

Luggage storage.detail: Policies page states: 'If you require early luggage drop-off, please provide prior notice,' confirming luggage can be held before official check-in with advance notice

wow_evidence: There are bicycle storage facilities on the premises
